variant.title: Palindrome
variant.description: Digits on each palindrome line are symmetric about the center.
rule.palindrome: Digits on each palindrome line are symmetric about the center.
rule_guide.title: Palindrome Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Digits on each purple palindrome line are symmetric about the center.
rule_guide.item_3: Symmetric positions must contain the same digit.
